metadata.title: CertGraph research artifact: Revisable Certificate Lineage for Active Directory Certificate Services under Incomplete Evidence
metadata.description:
Version 0.2.0 collects the original 72-case public laboratory artifact, later generated evidence-value and incremental-replay studies, stronger remediation baselines, and the revised anonymous manuscript and editable LaTeX sources. No additional live cases or investigator participants are claimed. See the package README for reproduction and interpretation boundaries.
